business_problem: Anker is pioneering power delivery technology to charge phones, tablets and laptops at unprecedented speeds, whether at home, in the car or on the go. Key to their ability to improve operations and margins is the use of data to optimize almost every aspect of the business — from automating manufacturing to using data insights to inform product road maps, marketing strategies and demand forecasting.
solution_summary: Anker built its Databricks implementation around Agent Bricks, Delta Lake, Delta Sharing, Unity Catalog. Anker is pioneering power delivery technology to charge phones, tablets and laptops at unprecedented speeds, whether at home, in the car or on the go. Key to their ability to improve operations and margins is the use of data to optimize almost every aspect of the business — from automating manufacturing to using data insights to inform product road maps, marketing strategies and demand forecasting. Agent Bricks provides the agentic and generative AI runtime used to build domain-specific applications. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Delta Sharing shares governed datasets with external partners and downstream consumers. Unity Catalog applies centralized governance, lineage, auditing, and access control across shared data assets.
